verdict.rationale: WorkOS documents an official remote MCP server that lets MCP-compatible AI agents act on your workspace. Through it, an agent can read and change the same dashboard data you can (organizations, connections, users, branding), so natural-language operation is possible. That operation depends on bringing an external MCP-capable agent, and the evidence describes neither a native natural-language interface nor the full extent of supported actions. Missing for 10: a built-in natural-language command interface in the product itself, detailed documentation of which operations the MCP server covers, and independent or hands-on corroboration that natural-language operation works in practice.
